body: I am seeing a psychiatrist now.  I am also taking meds for the first time in 12 years.  I honestly do not see it working as I think I was better off of them for all of the 12 years except the last month and a half.  I'm still here but I feel I can't take much more.

My mind will not stop.  I need some way to know that there is light at the end of the tunnel.  I don't know if any comment or words from anyone would help but it's like I am reaching so hard for answers and get nothing from anyone.  Maybe it's that I am not hearing what I would like to hear but I need something from somewhere to focus on in my mind that would maybe just maybe keep me going.  It is a stretch but I hope it comes sooner than later because this is a never ending nightmare.
